plugin.note: Magic only. Regular Cave krakens and Kraken are weak to earth spells; Ranged deals 1/7 damage and Melee cannot reach them. Regular Cave krakens can be protected against with Protect from Magic, while the Kraken boss uses typeless attacks.

requirements: Krack on unlock for 150-200 extended assignments
mechanics: Regular Cave krakens must be disturbed from whirlpools before they can be attacked.
Fishing explosives cannot be used to surface regular Cave krakens.
Magic is the only reliable damage style: Ranged deals 1/7 damage and Melee cannot reach them.
Regular Cave kraken attacks are magic damage and can be reduced with Protect from Magic.
Regular Cave krakens have a 50% elemental weakness to earth spells after surfacing.
The Kraken boss can be killed instead on the same assignment and is generally more profitable.
The Kraken boss uses typeless magic attacks, so protection prayers do not reduce damage.

methods.label: General strategy
methods.summary: Use magic for all Cave kraken task variants, choosing regular Cave krakens for the uncharged trident or collection log and Kraken boss for profit.
recommendedFor: choosing regular Kraken Cove kills or Kraken boss
prayers: Protect from Magic against regular Cave krakens
Offensive magic prayers for Kraken boss if bringing prayer potions
steps: Confirm the task is Cave kraken or Kraken before entering Kraken Cove.
Use magic only because Ranged and Melee are heavily penalised.
Use earth spells where practical to exploit the elemental weakness.
Kill regular Cave krakens only when pursuing uncharged trident or collection log goals.
Use the Kraken boss alternative for better profit and a simple boss fight.
notes: The task page links Kraken/Strategies for the full boss method.
Regular Cave krakens drop the uncharged trident at 1/200.

methods.label: Regular Cave kraken
methods.summary: Disturb regular whirlpools and kill surfaced Cave krakens with magic, usually only for uncharged trident or collection log goals.
requiredOrKeyItems: Earth spell runes or powered staff
steps: Attack or disturb a regular Cave kraken whirlpool to surface it.
Do not use fishing explosives for regular Cave krakens because they cannot surface these whirlpools.
Use magic, preferably earth spells or a strong powered staff.
Keep Protect from Magic active to reduce the regular Cave kraken's magic damage.
Loot uncharged trident, Kraken tentacle, clues, and Konar brimstone keys where applicable.
risks: Regular Cave krakens have low-value drops compared with the boss.
Ranged and Melee are not effective.

methods.label: Kraken boss alternative
methods.summary: Kill Kraken instead of regular Cave krakens when choosing the profitable boss option on the same assignment.
steps: Enter the Kraken boss room in Kraken Cove.
Use a fishing explosive on the large whirlpool to release Kraken and the four tentacles immediately.
Attack the Kraken directly and tank the tentacles.
Follow the dedicated Kraken/Strategies source for full inventory, instance, and sustain details.
notes: Kraken/Strategies is the authoritative boss method source.
Kraken's typeless magic damage cannot be blocked by protection prayers.

methods.label: Konar and Krack on
methods.summary: Use the page's assignment ranges and extension unlock when choosing whether to extend or Konar-lock Cave kraken tasks.
steps: Use Chaeldar's smaller 30-50 assignment range for shorter tasks.
Expect Konar 80-100 and Nieve/Duradel 100-120 base assignment ranges.
Enable Krack on only if the player wants 150-200 Cave kraken assignments.
On Konar tasks, stay within Kraken Cove and expect brimstone key eligibility.
notes: Krack on costs 100 Slayer reward points.

styleOptions.label: Magic earth spells
styleOptions.summary: Use earth spells to exploit the 50% elemental weakness.

styleOptions.label: Powered staff
styleOptions.summary: Use high-tier powered magic weapons when they outperform or simplify standard earth spell setups.

body: Cave krakens are a magic-only task in Kraken Cove. The task page recommends magic, notes the earth elemental weakness, contrasts regular Cave krakens with the more profitable Kraken boss, and points to Kraken/Strategies for the full boss method.
